research_question: Does a typed support restriction improve finite-sample support recovery and held-out composition prediction after conditioning on the same supplied graph?

population.graph_condition: one of 30 common-target two-source graphs is assigned per world and supplied identically to every arm
population.head_family_assignment: exactly 14 worlds in each of the nine ordered family-pair strata
population.nonzero_coefficients: generator values lie in {1,2,3}; selectors search all six nonzero Z_7 values
population.train_actions: uniform primitive action coordinate with magnitude 1 or 2

arms.support_search: the same nine supports represented in generic dictionary coordinates
seven greedy terms over 55 output-feature positions

information_symmetry.difference: support-search restriction and fitting algorithm only

theory_audit.interpretation: conservative sufficient upper envelopes, not lower bounds or a point prediction of an empirical crossing

high_grid_report.finding: all three arms recovered exactly in all 36 worlds from n=50 onward; the original grid had a ceiling defect

low_grid_report.role: grid selection and prospective power only

prospective_power.limitation: stratified bootstrap estimate from 36 development worlds

confirmatory_design.multiplicity: Bonferroni simultaneous two-sided normal intervals, familywise alpha 0.05

primary_estimands: world_mean generic_unstructured_greedy minus typed_structured_search composition NLL at each of eight n values
world_mean typed minus generic exact support-recovery indicator at each of eight n values

regions.joint_advantage: both simultaneous lower bounds exceed zero and both point estimates meet their endpoint-specific SESOI
regions.joint_equivalence: both simultaneous intervals are contained in their endpoint-specific equivalence margins
regions.transition_band: largest joint-advantage n through the smallest later joint-equivalence n; no point n-star is estimated

mechanism_controls: typed_structured_search and generic_isomorphic_search must have exactly equal predictions and composition NLL
world-level exact support recovery is reported beside composition NLL

cleanroom_and_external_replay.portable_scope: world specifications, train prefixes, and held-out inputs/targets sufficient to recompute every primary row
cleanroom_and_external_replay.independent_status_rule: the result is not called independently reproduced until a person outside the author workflow executes the replay

separate_robustness_estimands: A2 dictionary misspecification in both directions
program_stopping_rule: If neither A1 nor the separately frozen A2 width/noise conditions show a joint SESOI-qualified advantage, predictive-efficiency development stops and turnover/perception studies do not begin. Misspecification results characterize scope and cannot rescue the efficiency claim.
unresolved_before_freeze: publicly timestamped seed commitment before execution
forbidden_claims: a point prediction for n star from log binomial 55 choose 7
a blind benchmark result from public reference answers
independent replication before an external replay is completed
